questions.stem: At T(K), the equilibrium constant of $\mathrm{A_2(g) + B_2(g) \rightleftharpoons C(g)}$ is $2.7 \times 10^{-5}$. What is the equilibrium constant for $\mathrm{\frac{1}{3}A_2(g) + \frac{1}{3}B_2(g) \rightleftharpoons \frac{1}{3}C(g)}$ at the same temperature?
questions.solution:
$\mathrm{A_2 + B_2 \rightleftharpoons C} \qquad K_P = 2.7 \times 10^{-5}$
$\mathrm{\frac{1}{3}A_2 + \frac{1}{3}B_2 \rightleftharpoons \frac{1}{3}C} \Rightarrow K_P' = (K_P)^{1/3}$
$K_P' = (2.7 \times 10^{-5})^{1/3}$
$K_P' = (27 \times 10^{-6})^{1/3}$
$K_P' = 3 \times 10^{-2}$

questions.stem:
Consider the first order reaction $\mathrm{R \rightarrow P}$.
The fraction of molecules decomposed in the given first order reaction can be expressed as
questions.solution:
For 1st order reaction
$a - x = a e^{-K_1 t}$
$\Rightarrow x = a\left[1 - e^{-K_1 t}\right]$
$\Rightarrow \frac{x}{a} = \alpha = 1 - e^{-K_1 t}$

questions.stem:
2.0 g of a bromo hydrocarbon ( X ) was subjected to Carius analysis, gave 3.36 g of AgBr. The percentage of carbon in the compound (X) is 26.7 %. Total number of carbon atoms in the empirical formula for compound (X) is __________ .
(Given molar mass in $\mathrm{g\,mol^{-1}}$ H : 1, C : 12, Br : 80, Ag : 108 )
questions.solution:
$n_{Br} = \frac{3.36}{(108 + 80)}$
r = no. of Br atoms in organic compound
$n_{\text{organic compound}} = \frac{3.36}{(108 + 80) \times x} = \frac{2}{M}$
$M = \frac{2 \times 188 \times x}{3.36}$
$M = \frac{1}{2} \times x$
(x is integer)
$W_C = \frac{112 \times x \times 26.7}{100} = 30 \times x$
$n_C = \frac{30 \times x}{12} = 2.5 \times x$
take $x = 2$, $n_c = 5$

questions.stem:
The pH of a solution obtained by mixing 5 mL of 0.1 M $\mathrm{NH_4OH}$ solution with 250 mL of 0.1 M $\mathrm{NH_4Cl}$ solution is _________ $\times 10^{-2}$. (Nearest integer)
Given: $\mathrm{p}K_b(\mathrm{NH_4OH}) = 4.74$
questions.solution:
On mixing final volume = 255 ml
$\mathrm{[NH_3]} = \frac{5 \times 0.1}{255}$
$\mathrm{[NH_4Cl]} = \frac{250 \times 0.1}{255}$
$\mathrm{pOH} = \mathrm{p}K_b + \log\frac{\mathrm{[NH_4Cl]}}{\mathrm{[NH_3]}}$
$\mathrm{pOH} = 6.44$
$\mathrm{pH} = 14 - 6.44 = 7.56$

questions.stem:
A non-volatile, non-electrolyte solid solute when dissolved in 40 g of a solvent, the vapour pressure of the solvent decreased from 760 mm Hg to 750 mm Hg. If the same solution boils at 320 K, then the number of moles of the solvent present in the solution is __________ . (Nearest integer)
[Given: boiling point of the pure solvent = 319.5 K, $K_b$ of the solvent $= 0.3\ \mathrm{K\,kg\,mol^{-1}}$]
questions.solution:
$\frac{P^{\circ} - P_s}{P_s} = i.\text{molality} \times \frac{(\text{M.solvent})}{1000}$
$\Delta T_b = i.K_b.\ \text{molality} \Rightarrow \text{molality} = \frac{0.5}{0.3}$
(Molecular Mass) $= \frac{600}{75}$ g
Moles $= \frac{40}{600/75} = 5$
